o1.biggest_strength: It gets the big calls right: revive the paused winner, lead with taste, and address the ₹90 objection honestly, all in a voice that feels close to The Whole Truth.
o1.biggest_mistake: It adds quite a bit of media-plan detail and assumed budget that was not asked for, and it may run a little long for the brief.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Trim the extra testing mechanics, keep the launch plan tighter, and double-check every character count against actual Meta placements.

o2.biggest_strength: It is clean, practical, and correctly reads the data: the front-of-pack ad was tired, taste is the missing hook, and price needs to be tested upfront.
o2.biggest_mistake: The six angles are not quite different enough: transparency appears twice, taste and texture overlap, and the office-snack/protein angles are less fully covered.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Make the six copy routes more distinct: transparency, taste, no added sugar, protein, 4 pm snack, and price/value, with a little more blunt wit in the lines.

reason: I would rather use Output 1 because it gives me the broader, sharper copy set and sounds more like our brand. Output 2 is cleaner, but Output 1 better turns the data into ads I can actually launch.
